instruction: A candid athletic photograph in a full shot captures an indoor boxing gym. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1), wearing a white t-shirt and light blue sweatpants, stands in profile holding a black punching bag. On the right, the blonde woman in the lavender cropped hoodie (R2), wearing black leggings and brown boxing gloves, punches the bag with her left hand. The man stabilizes the bag as she strikes. The background features a gray concrete wall with yellow floor trim. Bright, even gym lighting illuminates the scene.
